scope: full source tree: src/*.rs, gui/src/main.rs, gui/fleet_gui.py, gui/fleet_lib.py, gui/test_fleet_lib.py, examples/*.rs, scripts/*.sh, Cargo.toml, gui/Cargo.toml, Makefile

findings.description: Two GUIs persist data-dir preference to different files (~/Library/Preferences vs ~/Library/Application Support)
"id-{N}" fallback serial never matched by later --serial lookups in CLI or GUI
GUI Add Firmware button wrote legacy flat layout, invisible to fleet firmware ls/pin/rollback and excluded from export
pair_devices pairs same-model bodies by enumeration order only, no per-unit identifier to cross-check
findings.disposition_reason: Mitigated with a loud warning when ambiguous (multiple same-model bodies); a real fix isn't possible with data the vendor SDK provides.

findings.description: model_slug logic hand-copied 7 places across CLI/Rust GUI/Python GUI instead of the canonical helper
cmd_firmware_pin strip_prefix bug rejected normal relative-path invocation with default data-dir "."
Present-but-empty USB serial silently becomes "", colliding two cameras onto the same snapshot filename
Tautology sweep is Python-AST-only; 166 of 225 Rust tests received zero mechanical tautology screening
findings.disposition_reason: Tooling limitation in tautology_sweep.py itself, outside this repo's tree — not fixable from nikon-fleet. Mitigated this pass by manual review + a 9-mutant spot-check (Phase 3), not a structural fix.

findings.description: cmd_ls --camera unanchored prefix match (e.g. "id-1" matches "id-10")
name_map_for_model duplicated verbatim between CLI and GUI
list_archives sorts firmware versions lexically, not numerically
--serial flag parsed but never used; exits 0 regardless
Always return Ok(()) regardless of accumulated failure counts
decode_enum_values casts w_physical_bytes to usize with no sign/bounds check
Unsanitized user label interpolated into filename then Path::join'd
set_reference except OSError too narrow for the json.loads/dict-index it also does
diff_with_schema never called from any CLI command despite being spec'd, tested, and implemented
No-FreeSDK rationale doesn't cover the Rust GUI's long-running init/drop-per-click pattern
findings.disposition_reason: Documented the gap honestly rather than changing Drop behavior blindly — verifying a real fix needs hardware not available in this environment.

findings.description: Python firmware scan never checks format_version, unlike list_archives
Re-parses 337k-line MaidLayer.config on every Take Snapshot click
firmware.bin compressed with Deflate; Python GUI deliberately uses Store
"Is this the reference snapshot" determined via fragile truncated-timestamp heuristic in both GUIs
findings.disposition_reason: Real fix needs a schema change (a back-link field) touching all 3 implementations (CLI + 2 GUIs). Severity assessment noted impact is a cosmetic UI badge only, not the actual reference data fleet check uses — cost/impact ratio didn't justify a rushed schema change in this pass.

findings.description: Schema-miss capabilities folded into read_ok with no drift visibility

No test pinned the double-digit-major version sort transition
model_slug hand-copy at >=5 sites, no parity test enforcing agreement
findings.disposition_reason: Addressed structurally in the High-round fix (#5): collapsed to one implementation per language rather than N copies. Cross-language golden-value tests already existed/were extended (TestModelSlug in Python, slug_replaces_spaces in Rust) using matching examples, consistent with this repo's existing bcd_decode_version cross-check convention.

No test for genuinely malformed/truncated JSON
